evidence_text: `invalid_input_cannot_evict_a_queued_signal`, `a_full_queue_drops_the_oldest_and_counts_it`; actual process restart/ACK cases below exercise cursor alignment.
statement: At checkpoint time, queued positions correspond to the remaining FIFO outbox entries. Only successful push adds a position; overflow removes the oldest pair; forwarding expiry drops its request/deadline pair; after flush the loop trims positions to remaining pending length. Outbox request/deadline entries are likewise paired.
